blocks.prompt: 10. Use factor theorem to find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) if \(-2\) and \(2\) are the roots of the polynomial \(2x^{3} + 4x^{2} + ax + b\).
blocks.explanation:
Root ka matlab woh value hai jo \(x\) ki jagah rakhne se polynomial zero ho jaye. Factor theorem ke mutabiq \(c\) root hai to \(f(c) = 0\) aur \(x - c\) factor hai.
Do roots diye hain, \(-2\) aur \(2\), to do equations milengi, aur do unknowns \(a\), \(b\) nikal aayenge.
Plan: \(f(-2) = 0\) aur \(f(2) = 0\), dono jama kar ke \(a\) khatam karna, phir \(b\) aur \(a\) nikalna. Dhyan rahe: yahan \(a\) polynomial ka coefficient hai, synthetic division wala \(a\) nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x^{3} + 4x^{2} + ax + b\); \(-2\) aur \(2\) is ke roots hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: Factor theorem: \(c\) root hai agar aur sirf agar \(f(c) = 0\). Har root ek equation dega, aur do equations se do unknowns hal ho jate hain.

Root \(x = -2\) istemal karein
\[f(-2) = 2(-2)^{3} + 4(-2)^{2} + a(-2) + b = 0\]
\[-16 + 16 - 2a + b = 0\]
\[-2a + b = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \(-2\) root hai, is liye \(f(-2) = 0\). Powers: \((-2)^{3} = -8\) (odd power, negative) aur \((-2)^{2} = 4\) (even power, positive). \(2 \times (-8) = -16\) aur \(4 \times 4 = 16\), jo aapas mein cancel ho gaye.

Root \(x = 2\) istemal karein
\[f(2) = 2(2)^{3} + 4(2)^{2} + a(2) + b = 0\]
\[16 + 16 + 2a + b = 0\]
\[2a + b = -32 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: \(2\) bhi root hai, is liye \(f(2) = 0\). \(2 \times 8 = 16\) aur \(4 \times 4 = 16\); dono ka jama 32 doosri taraf gaya to \(-32\) bana.

(1) aur (2) jama karein
\[2b = -32\]
\[b = -16\]
Kyun: (1) mein \(-2a\) aur (2) mein \(+2a\) hai; jama karne se \(a\) khatam ho gaya aur sirf \(b\) bacha. Phir 2 se divide kiya.

(1) se \(a\) nikalein
\[-2a + (-16) = 0\]
\[-2a = 16\]
\[a = -8\]
Kyun: \(b = -16\) ko (1) mein rakha, 16 ko doosri taraf le gaye, phir \(-2\) se divide kiya. Negative se divide karne par sign badal jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(x) = 2x^{3} + 4x^{2} - 8x - 16\]
\[f(-2) = -16 + 16 + 16 - 16 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[f(2) = 16 + 16 - 16 - 16 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a = -8\), \(b = -16\) rakh kar dono roots par polynomial ki value nikali; dono dafa zero aayi, is liye jawab sahi hai. Mazeed: \(f(x) = 2(x - 2)(x + 2)^{2}\), yani \(-2\) do dafa root hai.
